label: Warm Tool
description: Light, warm counterpart to Neutral Core. For small product apps that should feel like a helpful tool on a desk, not a dark developer shell.
signatureMotif: warm light chrome, clear primary actions, and desk-tool calm
promptHints: Invert Neutral Core: light surfaces, warm gray type, one terracotta or amber primary. Same app structure, different daylight.
Keep the scaffold routes and app vocabulary. Change only the visual temperature and density.
Buttons read as tools (Spara, Skapa) — not marketing CTAs.

layouts: App frame is a light top bar + optional slim nav. Content sits on warm white with a single focused view, not a dark IDE-like pane.
Primary work area is a form or list with 16–20px type and 8–12px gaps. Destructive actions stay visually secondary.
Settings and empty states use short sentences and one illustration-free helper line.
Keep scaffold file structure; restyle tokens, radius, and chrome only.
motifs: Background cream-white, cards white, borders warm gray. Radius 0.7rem.
Primary is a muted terracotta or amber — never electric blue on black.
Inter/Geist only. No display serifs. Icons outline, 18–20px.
antiPatterns: Do not keep Neutral Core's near-black background and cool blue primary as the default look.
Avoid marketing landing sections, hero claims, or pricing tables inside the app shell.
No neon, glass glow, or terminal mono as the UI font.
